response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong web/backend background (TypeScript, Node.js, D) and genuine strengths in testing culture, mentoring, and community teaching. However, the role's core minimum requirement — 8 years of C++ programming — is not close to being met; the resume shows roughly six months of C/C++ work at National Instruments (2014–2015) plus a C++ bachelor's project. Similarly, there is limited evidence of large-scale cloud compute platform, distributed systems at infrastructure scale (the Sociomantic low-latency work is the closest fit), or a formal technical leadership role owning platform strategy. The profile reads as a product/full-stack craftsman rather than a systems/infrastructure technical lead, so it does not clear the screening bar for this specific role.
strengths: Broad 15+ year engineering track record across web, mobile, embedded, and low-latency backend systems
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing: workshops, courses, conference talks, open-source tooling
Real high-throughput experience at Sociomantic (millions of HTTP req/s, async I/O, caching) plus DevOps/Kubernetes/CI exposure
concerns: C++ experience is roughly 6 months, far short of the 8-year minimum
No evidence of production cloud compute platform architecture or infrastructure ownership at scale
No formal technical leadership/lead role mentoring cloud or DevOps engineers over 2+ years

key_factors.factor: Large-scale infrastructure / cloud compute platform experience
Mentoring, testing culture, and breadth of engineering experience
